**Runs FerretDB 2 · macOS and Linux** · [registry page ↗](https://doze-dev.com/registry/doze/ferret/)

<!-- recipe:start -->

Run a document database your MongoDB drivers, `mongosh` and Compass connect to
unchanged, without running MongoDB.

MongoDB moved its server to the SSPL in 2018, a licence the OSI never approved.
This module speaks the MongoDB wire protocol instead: a FerretDB v2 gateway
(Apache-2.0) in front of a private PostgreSQL that carries Microsoft's
DocumentDB extension. You declare one block; doze runs the Postgres and the
gateway and shows you only the Mongo side. The block type is `ferret`, after
the gateway.

## A database

```hcl
module ferret "docs" {
  version = "2.7"
}
```

`version` is the FerretDB gateway's; the Postgres underneath comes with it.

```sh
doze url docs
# mongodb://docs.shop.doze:27017/
mongosh "$(doze url docs)" --eval 'db.runCommand({ ping: 1 })'
```

Hand it to an app by reference:

```hcl
app "api" {
  run  = "bun run dev"
  port = 3000
  env  = { MONGODB_URI = module.docs.url }
}
```

The first start does more work than later ones: doze creates the private
Postgres and its extension once. After that it wakes like any other service.
To get the first start out of the way, run `doze wake docs`.

## Databases, collections and seed data

```hcl
module ferret "shop" {
  version = "2.7"

  database "catalog" {
    collection "products" { seed = "./seed/products.json" }
    collection "orders" {}
  }
}
```

`seed` is a JSON array loaded into the collection when it is empty.

## Use it like Mongo

```sh
mongosh "$(doze url docs)" --eval '
  db.users.insertOne({ name: "Ada", roles: ["admin"] });
  printjson(db.users.find().toArray());
'
```

## What to expect

FerretDB aims at broad MongoDB compatibility, not all of it. If one command
matters to you, check the [FerretDB docs](https://docs.ferretdb.io/).

<!-- recipe:end -->

## Reference

A MongoDB-wire database you connect to with any Mongo client. Under the hood it is FerretDB v2 fronting a private PostgreSQL with Microsoft's DocumentDB extension — no MongoDB server, no license worries.

### Every field at once

<!-- ground:skip -->
```hcl
module ferret "shop" {
  version = "2.7"

  database "catalog" {

    collection "products" {

    seed = "./seed/products.json"

  }
    collection "orders" {}
  }
}
```

### Versions you can declare

The `version =` you write is the engine's own version. Declare a series and
doze pins its newest published build, or declare an exact build. Either way it
is fetched, verified and pinned in `doze.lock`, so it never moves on its own.

| `version =` | pins (today) | exact builds |
|---|---|---|
| `2` | `2.7.0` | 1 |

<details>
<summary>Every exact build, per series</summary>

**2**: `2.7.0`

</details>


### Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | string | — | FerretDB v2.x gateway version **Required.** |
| `seed` | string | — | path to a JSON array seeded into an empty collection |
| `settings` | map(string) | — | extra FERRETDB_* gateway settings |
| `auth` | bool | `false` | enable auth + user convergence (scaffold; needs validation) |

Every module block also takes doze's own fields: `port`, `listen`, `sleep`,
`after`, `enabled`, `routes`, `count` and `for_each`
([doze.hcl reference](/reference/doze-hcl/)).

### Nested blocks

**`database "<name>" { … }`** — a Mongo database to ensure (repeatable; label = name)

_The module does not list this block's fields yet._

**`collection "<name>" { … }`** — a collection within a database (repeatable; label = name)

_The module does not list this block's fields yet._

**`index { … }`** — an index on a collection (keys = {field=1\|-1}, unique)

_The module does not list this block's fields yet._

**`user { … }`** — a Mongo user when auth is on (name, password, database, roles)

_The module does not list this block's fields yet._

### Module releases

The releases of the module that provide this engine. doze picks the newest
one that fits your doze and your `version =`, and pins it in `doze.lock`;
you never write these. Older releases stay available for pinned lockfiles.

| Release | Engine versions | Platforms | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0.2.3` | 2 | 3 | **stable** |
| `0.2.2` | 2 | 3 |  |
| `0.2.1` | 2 | 3 |  |
